# Joel Bastone Lopez (JBL) — 3D Product CGI & Interactive WebGL Artist

> Photorealistic 3D product CGI, procedural LookDev, and interactive WebGL experiences (Three.js, WebGPU, Gaussian Splatting) for e-commerce brands, industrial manufacturers, and global creative agencies.

- Base: Buenos Aires, Argentina (GMT-3)
- Website: https://joelbastonelopez.com/
- Contact: joel.bastonelopez@gmail.com
- Core Specialization: 3D Product CGI, E-Commerce WebGL 3D Configurators, Hard-Surface Modeling, ZBrush Sculpting, Procedural PBR Shading, Unreal Engine 5 Real-Time Visualization.

## Commercial Case Studies
- [Primicia — Línea Lab](https://joelbastonelopez.com/project-primicia.html): Interactive real-time 3D luggage configurator built with Three.js.
- [8Bottle — Connected IoT Hardware Launch](https://joelbastonelopez.com/project-8bottle.html): Global crowdfunding launch visual ecosystem, procedural Cinema 4D blueprints, and photorealistic PBR liquid/droplet simulations.
- [MWO — Modular 3D Character Asset Pipeline](https://joelbastonelopez.com/project-mwo.html): High-fidelity modular character trait ecosystem, ZBrush organic sculpting, hard-surface Blender/C4D modeling, and turnkey GLB/OBJ deliverables.
- [KAISAR — Luxury Horology & Real-Time LookDev](https://joelbastonelopez.com/project-kaisar.html): High-precision luxury watch hard-surface CGI and Unreal Engine 5 real-time visualization.
- [Ducharme Seating — Large-Scale Venue ArchViz](https://joelbastonelopez.com/project-ducharme.html): Architectural photorealism, instanced raytracing, and kinematic rigging for international auditoriums.

## Technical Writing & Journal
- [Does Your Product Really Need an Interactive 3D Viewer?](https://joelbastonelopez.com/blog/interactive-3d-viewer-ecommerce.html): Strategic analysis and decision framework for e-commerce brands: Shopify conversion data, mobile load speed impacts, and when to choose catalog CGI vs animations vs interactive WebGL viewers.
- [Gaussian Splatting for E-Commerce in 2026](https://joelbastonelopez.com/blog/gaussian-splatting-ecommerce-2026.html): Technical deep dive into KHR_gaussian_splatting, WebGL/WebGPU mobile rendering, and the transition from classical polygonal 3D to volumetric neural representations.
